build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems with PBC support
build_radius_graph_single: build a radius graph for a single atomic system with soft or hard knn
compute_safe_norm: compute the L2 norm of a tensor with epsilon protection against division by zero
compute_soft_rank: compute soft rankings for pairwise distances using a sigmoid-based differentiable knn approach
compute_hard_rank: compute hard rankings for pairwise distances using exact argsort-based knn ranking
